Title: Public preview: New Azure Arc capabilities in November 2021

Body.Content:
Azure Arc is announcing new functionality in public preview. Azure Arc is getting additional machine learning functionality. Now, you can train and inference anywhere with Azure Arc. New functionality has also been added for Azure Arc-enabled data services. These updates enhance Azure Arc capabilities for servers, Kubernetes, app services, and data services anywhere.

Learn more.
